core_obligations: Construction (proof lines 5653-5666): take a hypercovering L of D with components in B (the hypercovering-site lemma); set K = u(L), which is a hypercovering; the preparation lemma gives a cartesian object E on (C/K)_total restricting to the E_{U_{n,i}} compatibly; the t-bound makes E bounded below; the bounded-modules equivalence writes E = a^*F with F in D^+(O_C).

The isomorphisms rho_U (lines 5673-5677): the construction of L_0 in the hypercovering-site lemma gives I_0 = Ob(B), so restricting the isomorphism a^*F = E to the components C/u(U) defines rho_U : F|_{C/u(U)} -> E_U.

Compatibility and uniqueness (lines 5679-5706): I_1 contains the triples (U, V, W, a, b) with component maps a, b : U -> V, W, so the preparation lemma's compatibility yields rho_a rho_V| = rho_U = rho_b rho_W|; taking (U, V, U, a, id_U) gives exactly the compatibility required by the locally-given situation; uniqueness of F follows from uniqueness of E in the preparation lemma (the transfer is the marked 'small detail omitted', see notes).
proof_roadmap: Adapt a hypercovering of D to B, transfer it to C, and build the cartesian object E on the total site.
Read off the isomorphisms rho_U from the degree-zero components.
Exploit the degree-one component (the maps a, b) for the compatibility with the rho_a; conclude uniqueness from E.
